spans: The first paid (Initial) Maintenance Term shall commence upon expiration of the Warranty Period and shall continue for twelve (12) months thereafter.

notes: This file is Schedule A to the master Software License, Customization and Maintenance Agreement, which it incorporates by reference; the substantive clauses for the yes/no categories live in that master agreement, not in this excerpt, so those categories are called No on the text actually present here. Document Name is borderline: the schedule's own heading is 'Product License Schedule' but the more meaningful contract name given in the same sentence is the referenced master Agreement, which is the answer used. Expiration Date is UNDETERMINED because the Initial Maintenance Term is pegged to expiry of the Warranty Period, whose own start (Installation Date) is listed as TBD. License Grant was considered borderline given the 'LICENSED PROGRAMS' heading and the no-charge licence/maintenance line, but no operative grant language appears in this excerpt, so it is called No.
